Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as AI slowdown fears hit chipmakers
Markets.summary: US stocks ended lower as Nvidia and other chipmakers declined following calls from AI leaders to slow development due to safety concerns. Rising Treasury yields, surging oil prices, and caution ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting also added pressure to the market.

Markets.title: CVC-backed Bamboo Insurance targets $3.24 billion valuation in US IPO
Markets.summary: CVC-backed residential property insurer Bamboo Insurance is targeting a valuation of up to $3.24 billion in its upcoming US initial public offering. The company plans to raise up to $700 million by offering 35 million shares priced between $18 and $20 each on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker BMB.

Markets.title: Copper price hits three-week low as inventories rise and dollar strengthens
Markets.summary: Copper prices fell below $14,000 a ton to a three-week low due to rising London Metal Exchange inventories and a stronger U.S. dollar. The metal has dropped 6.2% from last week's record high amid pressure from uncertain U.S. tariffs and tighter monetary policy.

Markets.title: US Senate Republicans release new crypto bill text ahead of critical vote
Markets.summary: US Senate Republicans released a revised version of the Clarity Act incorporating 126 changes requested by Democrats ahead of a critical procedural vote on Tuesday. The bill's passage remains uncertain due to Democratic concerns over ethics safeguards and banking industry opposition to stablecoin rewards.

Markets.title: Crypto data firm Kaiko secures $110 million funding round led by S&P Global
Markets.summary: Crypto data provider Kaiko has raised $110 million in a funding round led by S&P Global. The company plans to use the capital to expand its products and data business as mainstream financial interest in digital assets grows.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities recovered from Friday's lows due to easing oil prices and bond yields, though the Sensex and Nifty still closed lower. Persistent foreign outflows, weak market breadth, and geopolitical risks kept bears in control despite resilient domestic fundamentals.

Geo-Political.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
Geo-Political.summary: China has criticized suggestions that it is engaged in malicious competition regarding artificial intelligence development. This response follows comments by Anthropic's CEO advocating for an AI slowdown that prevents China from gaining an advantage.

Geo-Political.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
Geo-Political.summary: Russia struck a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other top European officials departed the station. Mr. Johnson condemned the attack, questioning the motives behind Russian President Vladimir Putin's decision to target the train.

Geo-Political.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
Geo-Political.summary: With over 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, Sweden's left-wing bloc held a narrow lead of about 20,000 votes. The election remains too close to call as vote counting continues.

Geo-Political.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
Geo-Political.summary: Three male wild dogs completed a record-breaking 2,500-mile journey across Zambia to find mates. Scientists state this extraordinary trek demonstrates that wildlife can still survive despite increasing environmental pressures.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people in Culiacán marched to demand an end to the surge in violence caused by a conflict between rival Sinaloa cartel factions. This regional violence escalated significantly after a feud broke out within the criminal organization.

Geo-Political.title: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
Geo-Political.summary: The body of missing runner Elizabeth Moselakgomo was found in South Africa following a nationwide search. Investigators discovered her remains near the bodies of four other women in the same area.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author tested ChatGPT recommendations and discovered their WordPress SaaS course was featured as the top organic result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic acquisition compared to traditional SEO in 2025.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to streamline and improve the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced AI tools from 2023 that automate tasks and improve workflow across industries. These widely used applications are designed to increase productivity and drive innovation.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article discusses the benefits of using AI content generators to create engaging and relevant material efficiently. It notes that with numerous tools available on the market, choosing the right one can be challenging.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide provides beginners with an overview of how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also outlines top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers common questions.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation breaches RBl's midpoint target for third successive month
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to a 20-month high of 4.82% in August due to high food and fuel prices. This marks the third consecutive month that inflation has breached the Reserve Bank of India's midpoint target.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale price inflation nears double digits in August; next month may be worse
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale price inflation remained near double digits in August and is expected to worsen next month. Businesses are passing these rising input costs on to consumers, which increases retail inflation beyond the RBI's target range.

Data & Insights.title: Trump says US should have world’s lowest interest rates ahead of Fed meeting: ‘I know more about formulas’
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of the September Federal Reserve meeting, Donald Trump stated that the United States should have the lowest interest rates in the world. Despite rising inflation and oil prices, he urged central bank officials to cut rates.

Data & Insights.title: Rate hikes are back? Kevin Warsh and G7 central banks face inflation test this week
Data & Insights.summary: Central banks in the US, UK, and Japan are holding key policy meetings this week to address ongoing inflation concerns. These decisions by Kevin Warsh and other global officials could significantly reshape the monetary policy outlook for 2026 and beyond.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 647 Rural Self Employment Training Institutes shift to digital platforms
Data & Insights.summary: India's 647 Rural Self Employment Training Institutes have replaced paper-based assessments with digital platforms to increase transparency and speed. This reform connects skills, certification, and credit to help rural youth build sustainable livelihoods.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Billionaire Club: Who’s richest in India, China, Russia, Brazil? Net worth of Ambani, Zhang Yiming, others
Data & Insights.summary: Billionaires from BRICS nations rank among the world's wealthiest individuals, spanning countries like India, China, Russia, and Brazil. On the sidelines of the BRICS Summit, Indian billionaire Gautam Adani met with South African President Cyril Ramaphosa to strengthen trade and investment ties.

India.title: Kolkata Roads Named After Marx, Lenin, Ho Chi Minh May Be Renamed
India.summary: Kolkata authorities are considering renaming three major roads currently named after communist figures Lenin, Karl Marx, and Ho Chi Minh. The affected streets are Lenin Sarani, Karl Marx Sarani, and Ho Chi Minh Sarani.

India.title: Bhagwant Mann's "Fake Turban' Jibe Sparks Fresh Political Row In Punjab
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann mocked political rival Sukhbir Singh Badal for wearing turbans during his repeated visits to the state. This jibe has sparked a fresh political controversy in Punjab.

India.title: "Extremely Heinous": KTR Alleges Attack On Aides In Hyderabad Police Station
India.summary: BRS leader KTR alleged that his aides were attacked inside a Hyderabad police station. He questioned whether Congress workers or plainclothes police officers were involved in a conspiracy.

India.title: Why Mumbai MLA With Rs 5,000 Crore Net Worth Became 'Beggar' For A Day
India.summary: Parag Shah, a Mumbai MLA with a net worth of Rs 5,000 crore, temporarily gave up his wealth and luxuries to live as a beggar for a day. He took this action following the advice of his spiritual guru.

India.title: SpiceJet Passengers Complain Of AC Malfunction, Airline Denies Charge
India.summary: Passengers on SpiceJet flight SG2471 from Delhi to Gorakhpur complained of an air conditioning malfunction on Sunday. The airline denied the charge regarding the flight, which was delayed by over an hour.

India.title: "She Didn't Stop, He Hit Her Bike": Rider Posts New Gurugram Hit-And-Run Clip
India.summary: A new video has emerged showing a rider's-eye view from behind of the recent hit-and-run incident in Gurugram. This footage complements the camera mounted on the victim's Aprilia RS 457 sports bike that captured the actual collision.

General.title: Man admits drugging and raping wife over 20 years
General.summary: An unnamed husband has pleaded guilty to more than 60 offenses for drugging and raping his wife over a 20-year period. The charges include multiple counts of rape and administering a substance with intent.

General.title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
General.summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark stated that artificial intelligence laboratories currently use various methods to shut down their systems. He suggested that having this "kill switch" capability may need to become a mandatory requirement for all labs.

General.title: Burnham cancels engagements after death of his father
General.summary: Andy Burnham cancelled his public engagements following the death of his father. His father was unaware that Burnham had become prime minister because he had Alzheimer's.

General.title: Farage says £72m donations are compliant 'with the law today'
General.summary: Nigel Farage stated that his party's £72 million in donations comply with current laws. Meanwhile, ministers are proposing a £100,000 annual limit on expat donations, backdated to March 25, 2026.

General.title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour after 'Free Palestine' speech
General.summary: US rapper Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour following a speech criticizing Israel. Jewish groups condemned the rapper for his remarks regarding the "Free Palestine" statement.
